# Asina Global

> Lower cost. Verified quality. Less import friction.

Asina Global supplies project-scale cabinets, quartz countertops, and custom furniture packages for builders, developers, procurement teams, restaurant teams, franchise rollout buyers, and commercial project buyers.

## What Asina Supplies

- Cabinet packages for project-scale residential, commercial, and rollout work.
- Quartz countertop slabs organized by collection, slab code, movement, size, thickness, edge needs, and cutout requirements.
- Custom commercial furniture packages for restaurants, franchises, outdoor areas, and repeat-location projects.
- Design-to-production support that turns layout, finish, custom sizing, room intent, and brand standards into production detail.
- Multi-unit cabinet package review for repeatable rooms, units, phases, and commercial builder work.
- Restaurant and franchise furniture package review for commercial venues, outdoor areas, and repeat-location rollouts.
- RFQ preparation support that keeps cabinet, countertop, and furniture package inputs clear before pricing.
- Project supply importer resources for landed cost questions, order scale, lead time, QA, packing, and shipping responsibility planning.
- Cabinet container loading planning for 40ft container, mixed SKU, packing, MOQ, and phase questions.
- Imported cabinet landed cost planning across product scope, freight, packing, handling, delivery, and responsibility level.
- Shipping responsibility planning for FOB, CIF, DAP, DPU, DDP, arrival documentation, and final quote terms.
- Imported cabinet quality planning around materials, mockup approval, production checks, packing, and documents.
- Cabinet lead time planning for builders comparing import supply, stock needs, phasing, and schedule risk.
- Import versus domestic cabinet comparison for buyers weighing speed, scale, cost picture, QA, repeatability, and accountability.
- Florida-to-nationwide commercial project supply support with exact Longwood office NAP data where address details are shown.

## Project Process

1. Submit project basics.
2. Send drawings, specs, plans, brand standards, or furniture files by email after initial review.
3. Complete a Project Supply Review covering value, feasibility, QA, packing, and shipping responsibility.
4. Approve a sample or mockup before repeat production.
5. Production proceeds against approved specifications with production QA.
6. Packing and shipping responsibility are reviewed before goods move.

## Key Facts

- Public form collects project basics only. No public uploads.
- Drawings and specs are requested by email after initial review.
- Asina follows up within 1-2 business days when the project appears to fit.
- Typical consultation and design finalization takes about 3 weeks.
- Production usually takes about 40 to 50 days, depending on order complexity and production capacity.
- DAP transit planning is typically 22 to 30 days to the West Coast and 40 to 50 days to the East Coast.
- Orders usually move in 20-foot or 40-foot containers.
- A 40HC container typically fits about 700 to 800 cabinet boxes.
- A 20H container typically fits about 370 cabinet boxes.
- Container fit changes with cabinet mix, box sizes, assembly state, accessories, packing protection, and category mix.
- Landed cost planning should include product scope, freight, packing, handling, delivery, and responsibility level.
- Full-container planning usually gives the strongest value, while smaller trial runs can be reviewed when tied to future volume.
- Moisture protection includes continuous lines of desiccant bags or silica gel packets along both sides of the container.
- Shipping responsibility and applicable Incoterms® 2020 planning are reviewed during consultation.
